supporting_observations.claim: The account v.rwong was created at 13:45:05 UTC by lena.ward, not at the alert's approximate 13:42 time.
The creation was attributed to a network logon by lena.ward from WS-LWARD-01 shortly beforehand.

v.rwong was added to the Vendors group immediately after creation. The v.<name> naming pattern and Vendors-only placement match the documented help-desk temporary-account practice, supporting a benign disposition.
lena.ward had launched Active Directory Users and Computers earlier in the review window, with LDAP activity to the domain controller, consistent with account-management work.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records do not include an account request, vendor identity, approval, or business justification for v.rwong.
The available group-add event shows membership in Vendors, but does not establish the account's complete group memberships or all account settings.
The supplied records do not show whether or how v.rwong was subsequently used.
claims_not_established: Whether the account creation corresponded to an approved vendor request.
Whether v.rwong had any additional privileges or memberships not represented in these records.
Whether the activity was performed by lena.ward herself or by another person using her session.
unrelated_findings: lena.ward initiated an RDP session to FILE-SUN-01. This is outside the documented remote-administration pattern, which specifies WS-IDOYLE-01; investigate separately, but the records do not show that it caused or was part of the account creation. (T248-00007, T248-00010, T248-00011)

Google Drive activity occurred on WS-LWARD-01: a browser connected to drive.google.com and GoogleDriveFS.exe was launched. Google Drive is not among the approved services; investigate separately. This does not by itself indicate that v.rwong's creation was malicious. (T248-00018, T248-00055, T248-00057)
